body:
Residual of #867 (`fix/867-nitrogen`); red-team r1 confirmed R1-R5, and R6 was found while drafting.

Tier: **A** (mechanical; costs one Malawi re-warm).
- `_organic_block` (`malawi.py:3007`) writes NA, because Module D records no organic quantity.
- `assemble_plot_inputs` (`malawi.py:3223-3229`) then aggregates `{'Quantity': 'sum', …}`, and an all-NA group sums to 0.0. So **11,075 of 11,075** `Organic Fertilizer` rows serve `Quantity == 0.0`, a measured zero the survey never recorded.
- The neighbouring `Quantity_purchased` aggregation (`:3142`) already uses `min_count=1`.
- Fix: `'Quantity': lambda s: s.sum(min_count=1)`, or the cython `min_count=1` form.
- No `nitrogen_kg` number depends on it, since organic rows get no share. Editing `malawi.py` moves every Malawi hash, so bundle it with R6.
title: Malawi organic-fertilizer `Quantity` is a fabricated 0.0 (`'Quantity': 'sum'` without `min_count`)
